name: Heme biosynthesis via protoporphyrinogen IX
rationale: All members are heme (A/B) or protoporphyrinogen IX biosynthesis, which separates the theme from iron-sulfur cluster assembly, erythrocyte differentiation and tetrapyrrole regulation confusables.

name: De novo purine and pyrimidine nucleotide biosynthesis
rationale: Members are de novo IMP/AMP/GMP/XMP and UMP/UDP/UTP synthesis, distinguishing the theme from purine salvage and nucleotide catabolism confusables.

name: Leptin signalling in appetite and body growth control
rationale: Members are leptin signalling and its regulation of food response, appetite and organism growth, separating it from feeding-behaviour and growth hormone/prolactin receptor confusables.

core: Mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
name: Wnt/BMP-driven mesenchymal stem cell proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are MSC proliferation/differentiation with Wnt and a BMP morphogen module, without the osteoblast and bone formation terms that define the confusables.

qualifier: midline (notochord/floor plate) and spinal neuron specification
name: Ventral midline patterning and spinal cord neuron specification
rationale: Members cover notochord/floor plate midline development, dorsoventral neural tube patterning and spinal motor neuron/interneuron fate, unlike the neural plate, hindbrain boundary and midbrain dopaminergic confusables.

name: Sleep-wake regulation and innate mating, parental, aggressive behaviours
rationale: Members are sleep/wake stage regulation and innate social, reproductive and drinking behaviours, distinct from the neuropeptide/opioid G-protein signalling and feeding/locomotor confusables.

name: Mitochondrial tRNA processing and modification
rationale: All members concern mitochondrial tRNA processing, 3'-end maturation and modification, whereas confusables cover mitochondrial rRNA/mRNA modification, ribosome assembly and tRNA aminoacylation.

qualifier: nucleoprotein maturation and SARS-CoV host-signalling/PDZ targeting
name: Viral nucleoprotein maturation and SARS-CoV host-protein targeting
rationale: Members are SARS-CoV/RSV nucleoprotein maturation and SARS-CoV targeting of host PDZ and signalling proteins, unlike confusables on bacterial entry, nuclear transport or spike/E/3a maturation.

qualifier: ER/mitochondrial UPR, heat shock and CCT/TriC chaperonin folding
name: UPR, heat shock response and chaperonin-mediated protein folding
rationale: Members span ER and mitochondrial UPR, eIF2 kinase stress signalling, HSF1 heat shock and CCT/TriC-prefoldin folding, distinct from FOXO, ER translocation/ERAD and stress-granule confusables.

qualifier: polyubiquitin chain linkage types and E3 ligase action
name: Polyubiquitin chain linkage types and E3-directed proteasomal degradation
rationale: Members are K6/K11/K27/K29/branched chain formation, E3 ligase ubiquitination and promotion of proteasomal degradation, unlike DUB/E1-E2, degron-rule and ERAD/quality-control confusables.

qualifier: IL-23/IL-17 Th17 axis, IL-10 family and IL-1 family (IL-33/36/38)
name: IL-23/IL-17, IL-10-family and IL-1-family interleukin signalling
rationale: Members are IL-17, IL-23/IL-12, IL-10/IL-20 and IL-33/IL-36/IL-38 signalling, distinct from interferon, C-type lectin antifungal and IL-27/IL-35 confusables.

qualifier: termination, NMD and stalled-ribosome quality control
name: Translation-coupled mRNA surveillance and ribosome quality control
rationale: Members cover translation termination, NMD, no-go/non-stop decay and stalled ribosome rescue, unlike nuclear RNA decay, translation initiation and mRNA 3'-end processing confusables.

qualifier: dopaminergic neurons and cerebellar granule layer
name: Midbrain dopaminergic neuron and cerebellar development
rationale: Members are midbrain dopaminergic/substantia nigra and monoaminergic axon development plus cerebellar granule precursor, Bergmann glia and motor learning, unlike forebrain, glial-fate and spinal confusables.

name: Regulation of receptor internalization and lysosomal degradation
rationale: Members regulate receptor internalization, recycling, surface localization and lysosomal catabolism, without the LDL clearance/sterol homeostasis or endosome-transport terms of the confusables.

name: Flippase-mediated aminophospholipid translocation and membrane trafficking
rationale: Members are aminophospholipid flipping and phospholipid transport regulation with ATP11B/TMEM30A flippase trafficking modules, unlike ABC floppase, scramblase and ER-Golgi lipid transfer confusables.

name: Fas/TRAIL death receptor-caspase-8 extrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members are FasL/TRAIL signalling, procaspase-8 activation, c-FLIP, BID and T-cell activation-induced death, distinct from the necroptosis and TLR3/TRIF death confusables.

name: CNS neuron, astrocyte and oligodendrocyte differentiation balance
rationale: Members regulate neuron, astrocyte, oligodendrocyte and Bergmann glia differentiation and neuroblast proliferation, unlike forebrain progenitor, Schwann/myelination and retina/forebrain patterning confusables.

qualifier: ApoB lipoproteins and LDL-receptor family turnover
name: ApoB-lipoprotein remodeling, clearance and LDL-receptor family turnover
rationale: Members are chylomicron/VLDL/LDL remodeling and clearance with LDLR/VLDLR internalization and degradation, unlike HDL, cholesterol efflux/biosynthesis and intestinal absorption confusables.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation control in epidermal repair
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and apoptosis plus epidermal wound healing, unlike keratinocyte migration, cornification/barrier and hair follicle/melanocyte confusables.

qualifier: rostrocaudal somite patterning and axis elongation
name: Somite segmentation and posterior axis elongation
rationale: Members are somite specification, rostral/caudal patterning, LFNG segmentation and tail/axis elongation, distinct from neural plate, limb, Hox cluster and Notch glycosylation confusables.

name: Glycerol/polyol and mono-/diacylglycerol metabolism with endocannabinoid signalling
rationale: Members cover glycerol and polyol metabolism/transport, DAG/MAG/PA turnover and N-acylethanolamine endocannabinoids, unlike triglyceride lipolysis, phospholipid synthesis/remodeling and lipid droplet confusables.

name: Nucleoside phosphorylation, interconversion and deoxyribonucleotide synthesis
rationale: Members are NMP/NDP phosphorylation, nucleotide interconversion and dNTP/dTTP synthesis, unlike de novo ribonucleotide biosynthesis and nucleotide catabolism confusables.

name: Emi1 inhibition of APC/C and its SCF-betaTrCP removal
rationale: Members concern Emi1 phosphorylation and SCF-betaTrCP degradation, inhibition of APC/C ligase activity and CDK control at metaphase-anaphase, unlike confusables on APC/C-Cdc20/Cdh1 substrate degradation.

name: IFN-gamma signalling and MHC expression regulation
rationale: Members are type II interferon signalling and its regulation, MHC class I/II induction and T cell antigen presentation, unlike the Th1 differentiation, IL-12 and dendritic cytokine confusables.

name: Ribosome quality control and degron-directed nascent-chain degradation
rationale: Members are RQC/RQT handling of stalled ribosomes and N-end/C-end degron ubiquitin degradation, without the NMD and translation termination terms, ERAD or stress granule terms of the confusables.
